name: Cropster Agro Ltd.
summary: Cropster Agro Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing, processing, and global trade of a diverse range of industrial materials. Its activities encompass producing, coating, and treating substances such as chemicals, plastics, rubber, leather, foam, and cellulose, in addition to importing, exporting, purchasing, selling, and acting as an agent for these goods. Mayank Kumar founded the company on May 17, 1985, and its corporate base is situated in Ahmedabad, India.
